system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes seated beside Dr. Watson in a dim bedroom, Helen Stoner standing before them in a plain high-necked dress and shawl","action":"Holmes listens intently, head slightly bowed, while Watson leans forward; Helen gestures faintly toward the window as if recalling the strange words she heard","setting":"Old chamber at Stoke Moran, west wing under repair, plain Victorian furnishings, a small bed and washstand, the room's stone walls softened by shadow","secondaryElements":"A dim oil lamp on a side table casting warm pools of light; a heavy curtain drawn over the window; a folded shawl and a plain handkerchief on the chair; distant trees of the plantation faintly visible beyond the glass","mood":"Tense, restrained and intimate, with a gothic undercurrent of unease and a detective's unhurried attentiveness","timeOfDay":"Night, deep in the small hours before dawn","composition":"Medium interior shot framed through the bedroom doorway, Holmes and Watson in the left foreground, Helen centred, lamp glow dominating the lower right, dark room receding into shadow"}
